[P2] Plan the breaking StepConfig contract change

This still breaks existing callers that never enable the feature: `StepConfig().step_semantics.value` now raises, and assigning the field to a `StepSemantics` variable fails type checking. The new Migration section explains a workaround, but no breaking-release plan is identified, and the package remains on 3.1.0. CONTRIBUTING rule 1.3 requires existing capabilities to follow the breaking-change release process. Please return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6) and agree on either a compatible execution-default design or an explicitly planned breaking release.
